items.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005
items.q: Howard Voorhees, the man that got me into the Orpheum Theater, and the Forest Club.

ctx.x: How did you do that? How did you learn to do that articulation?
Oh, Howard Voorhees, the man that got me into the Orpheum Theater, and the Forest Club.
Really? He showed you how to do that?
